t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnome will always appaer in  a fixed combination of pairs. Orange, Green, Red and Blue gnome will always lead me to bright forest. I need to find forest with the most mushroom. Other thing is irrelevant, except gnome's color.

vb_textbox.text: In this game, there will be two forests, and orange, green, red and blue gnome will always lead you to dark forest. For the other gnome, they will lead you to the bright forest. Only the color of the gnome matters in the game.Usually when one forest has good yield, the other forest will have poor yield. To perform better than others, don't switch forest when your yield is greater than the average (9 / 2 = 4.5). If your yield from a forest is lower than 4.5, pick the other forest the next time, repeat until your yield is above average again.
